title: SSC CGL 2026 Notification Out: Apply Online for 15000+ Posts
examName: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) Combined Graduate Level (CGL) 2026
shortDescription: SSC has released the official notification for CGL 2026. Check eligibility, age limit, syllabus, and application process. Apply before the last date.
content:
SSC CGL 2026 Recruitment Highlights

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) ne CGL 2026 ka official notification release kar diya hai. Agar aapne graduation complete kar li hai, toh yeh aapke liye ek golden opportunity hai Sarkari Naukri paane ki.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date: 15 September 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 14 October 2026
  • Tier 1 Exam Date: December 2026 (Tentative)

Eligibility & Age Limit

Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in any stream from a recognized university.

Age Limit: Minimum 18 years and Maximum 27-32 years (post-wise vary karta hai). OBC/SC/ST candidates ko government rules ke hisaab se age relaxation milega.

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS: ₹100
  • SC/ST/Women/ESM: Free (Exempted)

Photo and Signature Upload Rules (Very Important)

SSC forms mein photo aur signature upload karna sabse tricky part hota hai. Agar size galat hua, toh form direct reject ho jayega!

  • Photograph: 20KB to 50KB ke beech honi chahiye (JPEG/JPG format). Photo 3 mahine se zyada purani nahi honi chahiye aur spectacles (chashma) allowed nahi hai.
  • Signature: 10KB to 20KB ke beech (JPEG/JPG). Blur signature turant reject hote hain.
